title: Lens Debaser AI Preset Authoring Schema

syntax.guidance: Write only controls intentionally changed from their defaults. Do not serialize Input Working Space or Diagnostic View.

ai_delivery_requirements.output: Create and attach a finished downloadable .ldbpreset file; do not require the user to copy source text, use a text editor, rename a file, or run a command.
ai_delivery_requirements.self_check: Before delivery, reopen the generated file and verify its header, every key and value, duplicate keys, dependencies, and required second inputs against this schema.
ai_delivery_requirements.revision: Deliver every requested revision as a newly named downloadable .ldbpreset so earlier versions remain available for comparison.

anamorphicDistortion.label: Cylindrical Distortion
anamorphicDistortion.description: Independent signed cylindrical field distortion; not a desqueeze.

anamorphicFlareAmount.label: Flare Amount
anamorphicFlareAmount.description: Amount of dedicated horizontal highlight flare.

anamorphicFlareAsymmetry.label: Flare Asymmetry
anamorphicFlareAsymmetry.description: Biases the streak tail to one side of each highlight.

anamorphicFlareBandAmount.label: Flare Bands
anamorphicFlareBandAmount.description: Adds layered horizontal streaks around the primary flare.

anamorphicFlareBandSeparation.label: Band Separation
anamorphicFlareBandSeparation.description: Vertical spacing between the layered flare bands in output pixels.

anamorphicFlareCoreAmount.label: Flare Core
anamorphicFlareCoreAmount.description: Adds a concentrated high-energy core inside the broader streak.

anamorphicFlareGhostAmount.label: Reflection Amount
anamorphicFlareGhostAmount.description: Adds a bounded analytic internal reflection for the dominant coherent source.

anamorphicFlareGhostCount.label: Reflection Paths
anamorphicFlareGhostCount.description: Number of bounded analytic internal-reflection paths.

anamorphicFlareGhostEnergyDecay.label: Reflection Energy Decay
anamorphicFlareGhostEnergyDecay.description: Relative energy retained by each successive reflection path.

anamorphicFlareGhostPosition.label: Reflection Position
anamorphicFlareGhostPosition.description: Positions the ghost relative to the optical centre; negative values invert its movement.

anamorphicFlareGhostScale.label: Reflection Scale
anamorphicFlareGhostScale.description: Scales the filled elliptical reflection primitive.

anamorphicFlareGhostScaleDecay.label: Reflection Size Decay
anamorphicFlareGhostScaleDecay.description: Relative size retained by each successive reflection path.

anamorphicFlareGhostSpacing.label: Reflection Spacing (px)
anamorphicFlareGhostSpacing.description: Spacing between analytic reflection paths in output pixels.

anamorphicFlareSecondaryAmount.label: Secondary Streak
anamorphicFlareSecondaryAmount.description: Adds an independently displaced secondary horizontal streak.

anamorphicFlareSecondaryOffset.label: Secondary Offset
anamorphicFlareSecondaryOffset.description: Vertical displacement of Secondary Streak in output pixels.

anamorphicFlareThickness.label: Flare Thickness
anamorphicFlareThickness.description: Vertical thickness of primary, layered and secondary flare streaks.

anamorphicFlareThreshold.label: Flare Threshold
anamorphicFlareThreshold.description: Scene-linear highlight threshold for Anamorphic Flare.

anamorphicSqueeze.label: Anamorphic Field Aspect
anamorphicSqueeze.description: Shapes the complete off-axis lens field; this is not an image desqueeze.

apertureAspect.label: Pupil Aspect
apertureAspect.description: Stretches any circular, polygonal or oval pupil before off-axis Cat-Eye and Bokeh Swirl deformation.

apertureBladeCount.label: Blade Count
apertureBladeCount.description: Whole-number blade count. High counts approach a circular iris.

apertureBladeCurvature.label: Blade Curvature
apertureBladeCurvature.description: Rounds polygonal blades toward a circular response.

apertureBokehSwirl.label: Bokeh Swirl
apertureBokehSwirl.description: Tangentially reshapes off-axis aperture footprints with a smooth, bounded response. Values above 1 extend through the creative range.

apertureCatEye.label: Cat-Eye
apertureCatEye.description: Compresses the pupil radially toward the frame edge.

aperturePupilClip.label: Pupil Clipping
aperturePupilClip.description: Asymmetrically clips the off-axis pupil at the lens-barrel boundary.

aperturePupilShift.label: Pupil Shift
aperturePupilShift.description: Displaces the off-axis pupil along the radial field direction.

apertureRadius.label: Aperture Radius (px)
apertureRadius.description: Spatial size of the aperture response in pixels.

apertureResponse.label: Aperture Amount
apertureResponse.description: Enables and mixes shaped aperture and bokeh processing. Zero bypasses the aperture stage and its processing cost; external depth holds Focus Depth sharp and increases defocus away from it.

apertureRimWeight.label: Pupil Rim Weight
apertureRimWeight.description: Moves bokeh energy between a soft centre and a brighter pupil rim.

apertureRotation.label: Aperture Rotation (°)
apertureRotation.description: Rotates polygonal or oval aperture response in degrees.

apertureSoftness.label: Edge Softness
apertureSoftness.description: Redistributes pupil energy toward the centre for a progressively softer aperture boundary.

astigmatism.label: Astigmatism
astigmatism.description: Directional off-axis focus split; sign swaps orientation.

bloomHorizontalStretch.label: Bloom Stretch
bloomHorizontalStretch.description: Horizontal bloom aspect; requires Bloom Amount.

captureAperture.label: Aperture (f-number)
captureAperture.description: Capture context used to scale active pupil and highlight responses.

captureFocalLength.label: Focal Length (mm)
captureFocalLength.description: Capture context used to scale active off-axis responses.

captureFocusDistance.label: Focus Distance (cm)
captureFocusDistance.description: Capture context from 1 cm to 10 m; 1000 represents infinity focus.

captureInfluence.label: Capture Influence
captureInfluence.description: Blends Capture mapping from no influence to full influence.

chromaticFieldFalloff.label: Chromatic Transition Width
chromaticFieldFalloff.description: Transition width from independent Chromatic Onset to full separation; inactive while Onset is -1.

chromaticFieldOnset.label: Chromatic Onset
chromaticFieldOnset.description: -1 follows the shared Field envelope. Set 0 or higher to begin chromatic separation at an independent radius.

cleaningMarks.label: Cleaning Marks
cleaningMarks.description: Curved directional wiping traces that locally increase highlight scatter.

coatingWear.label: Coating Wear
coatingWear.description: Patchy loss of anti-reflective coating, changing local contrast, color and flare.

comaThreshold.label: Coma Threshold
comaThreshold.description: Scene-linear highlight level at which coma begins.

damageScale.label: Mark Scale
damageScale.description: Spatial scale of cleaning marks and scratches.

damageSeed.label: Damage Seed
damageSeed.description: Whole-number selector for a stable front-element damage pattern.

depthEdgeSoftness.label: Depth Edge Softness
depthEdgeSoftness.description: Adjusts depth-layer tolerance at soft or noisy map boundaries.

depthFar.label: Input Far
depthFar.description: Input-map value remapped to the normalized far endpoint.

depthFocus.label: Focus Depth
depthFocus.description: Normalized depth plane held in focus; longitudinal color increases away from this value.

depthNear.label: Input Near
depthNear.description: Input-map value remapped to the normalized near endpoint.

detailScale.label: Detail Scale
detailScale.description: Feature size affected by Detail Transfer.

diffractionRayAmount.label: Vertical Rays
diffractionRayAmount.description: Adds smooth full-resolution analytic diffraction rays to coherent flare sources.

diffractionRayLength.label: Ray Length
diffractionRayLength.description: Vertical extent of diffraction rays in output pixels.

effectBlend.label: Effect Blend
effectBlend.description: Final dry/wet blend in increments of 0.001.

fieldAspect.label: Field Aspect
fieldAspect.description: Aspect of the independent focus and off-axis response field.

fieldRotation.label: Field Rotation (°)
fieldRotation.description: Rotation of the independent focus and off-axis response field.

finalAutoCropAdjustment.label: Adjust Auto
finalAutoCropAdjustment.description: Increase or reduce the automatic crop to fine-tune unwanted edge effects.

finalFramingMode.label: Auto Fill Frame
finalFramingMode.description: 0 disables automatic edge cropping; 1 enables it. Adjust Auto is active only at 1; Manual Crop only at 0. Both adjustments default to zero and retain independent values.

finalManualCrop.label: Manual Crop (%)
finalManualCrop.description: Crop into the image to remove unwanted effects along its edges.

fineDetail.label: Fine Detail
fineDetail.description: Fine-frequency transfer without conventional sharpening halos.

frontHaze.label: Cleaning Haze
frontHaze.description: Broad forward scatter from accumulated micro-abrasion and polishing haze.

geometryFieldAmount.label: Geometry Field Mix
geometryFieldAmount.description: Blends conventional distortion into the Shared Field envelope. Zero leaves distortion global. Does not gate projection.

glareColorAmount.label: Glare Color Amount
glareColorAmount.description: Mixes the Glare Color into glare.

glareThreshold.label: Glare Threshold
glareThreshold.description: Scene-linear highlight level at which glare begins.

imageCircleAspect.label: Image Circle Aspect
imageCircleAspect.description: Boundary aspect used by Mechanical Vignette.

imageCircleSize.label: Image Circle Size
imageCircleSize.description: Boundary size used by Mechanical Vignette.

imageCircleSoftness.label: Image Circle Softness
imageCircleSoftness.description: Boundary softness used by Mechanical Vignette.

internalDirtAmount.label: Internal Dirt Amount
internalDirtAmount.description: Amount of softer deposits trapped between internal lens elements. Values through 2 cover the natural range; 2 to 10 progressively extends into pronounced and extreme density.

internalDirtComplexity.label: Cloud Complexity
internalDirtComplexity.description: Adds progressively smaller overlapping density structures without image-plane noise.

internalDirtScale.label: Internal Dirt Size
internalDirtScale.description: Spatial size of internal dirt and residue regions.

internalDirtScatter.label: Internal Scatter
internalDirtScatter.description: Veiling scatter and softened highlight structure caused by internal dirt.

internalDirtSeed.label: Internal Dirt Seed
internalDirtSeed.description: Whole-number selector for a stable internal-element dirt distribution.

internalDirtSmear.label: Internal Smear
internalDirtSmear.description: Elongates internal deposits into soft displaced residue.

internalDirtSoftness.label: Cloud Softness
internalDirtSoftness.description: Controls the boundary softness of internal optical-density clouds.

longitudinalCA.label: Longitudinal Amount
longitudinalCA.description: Near/far focus color separation around local focus transitions.

longitudinalCARadius.label: Longitudinal Radius (px)
longitudinalCARadius.description: Feature scale used to identify near- and far-focus transitions.

lookAnamorphicBias.label: Classic 2x Anamorphic Bias
lookAnamorphicBias.description: Adds an exaggerated classic 2x anamorphic field, flare, chromatic and pupil character.

lookCharacter.label: Character
lookCharacter.description: Adds a coordinated amount of general optical character.

lookExoticBias.label: Exotic Bias
lookExoticBias.description: Biases the visible direct model toward asymmetric and anamorphic character.

lookInfluence.label: Look Amount
lookInfluence.description: Overall amount of the coordinated Look macro contributions. Zero removes those contributions.

lookVintageBias.label: Vintage Bias
lookVintageBias.description: Biases the visible direct model toward vintage response.

lookVintageCaricatureBias.label: Vintage Caricature
lookVintageCaricatureBias.description: Exaggerates the familiar softness, glow, colour and field character of vintage optics.

opticalDriftAmount.label: Drift Amount
opticalDriftAmount.description: Moves the energy centre of growing defocus without shifting the sharp image; sign reverses the selected direction.

opticalDriftAngle.label: Drift Angle (°)
opticalDriftAngle.description: Lens-space direction in degrees when Drift Direction is Directed.

peripheralStretch.label: Peripheral Stretch
peripheralStretch.description: Expands or compresses image structure toward the perimeter inside the geometry field.

peripheralWarp.label: Peripheral Warp
peripheralWarp.description: Adds smooth irregular optical edge deformation instead of a purely radial barrel curve.

prismAmount.label: Prism Amount
prismAmount.description: Strength of smooth directional refraction entering from the selected edge.

prismDirection.label: Prism Direction
prismDirection.description: Direction from the protected side toward the refracted edge, in degrees.

prismDispersion.label: Prism Dispersion
prismDispersion.description: Wavelength separation along the coherent prism displacement.

prismEdgeBias.label: Prism Edge Bias
prismEdgeBias.description: Moves the prism transition toward the selected edge.

prismSoftness.label: Transition Width
prismSoftness.description: Width of the smooth transition into the refracted region.

projectionAmount.label: Amount (%)
projectionAmount.description: Blends ideal projection geometry. Zero preserves the existing lens treatment.

projectionFieldAngle.label: Field Angle (half-diagonal °)
projectionFieldAngle.description: Angle from the optical axis to a frame corner, in degrees (half the diagonal field of view). Zero disables projection. Near 89° some framings magnify heavily. Independent of Shared Field controls.

projectionFraming.label: Framing
projectionFraming.description: Fill Frame magnifies to keep the frame filled; Balanced trades magnification against edge coverage; Preserve Centre Scale maintains central scale and may stretch source boundaries.

refractiveAnisotropy.label: Directionality
refractiveAnisotropy.description: Stretches refractive variation along one direction.

refractiveDispersion.label: Irregular Dispersion
refractiveDispersion.description: Adds wavelength-dependent separation along the local refractive displacement.

refractiveEdgeBias.label: Edge Bias
refractiveEdgeBias.description: Moves refractive irregularity from the full glass toward the perimeter.

refractiveIrregularity.label: Irregularity Amount
refractiveIrregularity.description: Stable local magnification and displacement from uneven glass thickness or refractive index.

refractiveScale.label: Irregularity Scale
refractiveScale.description: Spatial size of refractive pockets and waves.

refractiveSeed.label: Irregularity Seed
refractiveSeed.description: Whole-number selector for a stable refractive field.

responseDefocusFalloff.label: Full Defocus Distance
responseDefocusFalloff.description: Normalized depth distance from Focus Depth at which defocus reaches full strength. This is an endpoint, not a transition width.

responseDefocusOnset.label: Defocus Onset
responseDefocusOnset.description: Depth distance where active defocus responses begin.

responseFieldFalloff.label: Field Transition Width
responseFieldFalloff.description: Normalized transition width over which active off-axis responses build from Field Onset to full strength.

responseFieldOnset.label: Field Onset
responseFieldOnset.description: Normalized radius where active off-axis responses begin.

responseHighlightKnee.label: Threshold Softness
responseHighlightKnee.description: Softens extraction around the thresholds of active bloom, glare, halo, coma and flare. Does not soften final-image highlight tone.

responseScatterEdgeProtection.label: Depth Edge Protection
responseScatterEdgeProtection.description: Controls cross-layer rejection for depth-aware aperture and scatter.

scratchAmount.label: Deep Scratches
scratchAmount.description: Sparse persistent scratches that flare under strong illumination.

scratchDirection.label: Scratch Direction
scratchDirection.description: Dominant cleaning and scratch direction in degrees.

sphericalHalo.label: Spherical Halo
sphericalHalo.description: Smooth highlight halo approximating spherical aberration.

swirl.label: Geometric Swirl
swirl.description: Rotates image coordinates around Optical Center; independent of Bokeh Swirl.

transmissionColorAmount.label: Color Amount
transmissionColorAmount.description: Mixes the Transmission Color into lens throughput.

transmissionContrast.label: Transmission Contrast
transmissionContrast.description: Signed scene-linear contrast around 18 percent grey.

transmissionHighlightSoftness.label: Highlight Softness
transmissionHighlightSoftness.description: Compresses positive highlights while preserving middle grey.

variationAmount.label: Variation Amount
variationAmount.description: Parent blend for deterministic lens-to-lens variation.

variationFieldAsymmetry.label: Field Asymmetry
variationFieldAsymmetry.description: Seeded asymmetry of active off-axis response.

variationPupilIrregularity.label: Pupil Irregularity
variationPupilIrregularity.description: Seeded irregularity of an active aperture footprint.

vignetteMechanical.label: Mechanical Vignette
vignetteMechanical.description: Mixes in the defined image-circle boundary.

dependencies.note: Aperture shape and Optical Drift controls are opt-in and have no image effect until Aperture Response is active. Optical Drift moves only the energy centre of growing defocus. This is one of the more expensive responses.
Axial color settings shape active longitudinal chromatic aberration.
Image Circle shapes mechanical vignette coverage.
Prism routing and shaping need Prism Amount. Field Shape positions Bilateral, Radial and Inverse modes.
Internal contamination detail settings need Internal Dirt Amount.
Capture remaps compatible active optical responses; it does not create a complete lens treatment by itself.
Depth Input modifies depth-aware Aperture Response, longitudinal color, spherical halo, and bloom/glare occlusion; it does not create those responses by itself.
Field Shape routes and gates other spatial responses and may be visually neutral on its own.

final_framing_guidance: Final Framing crops the completed optical result. Positive Adjust Auto increases automatic crop, negative reduces it and may reveal unwanted edges. Manual Crop is nonnegative. Both values are retained independently. Leave Auto Fill off and Manual Crop at zero to preserve framing. Cropping enlarges retained detail and can soften insufficient-resolution sources. Auto Fill is approximate, not a guarantee for every extreme distortion or source border.
performance_guidance: Aperture Response and combined chromatic defocus are the most expensive common paths; add them deliberately.
Geometry, prism, detail transfer, vignette and simple transmission treatments are generally lighter.
Prefer the fewest active responses that express the intended optical character, then validate on moving footage and highlights.
